Description: Transitional mosque in Purana Qila showcasing pointed arches and marble inlay. Citations: Percy Brown (1942), 'Indian Architecture: Islamic Period'; Catherine B. Asher (1992), 'Architecture of Mughal India'.
Octagonal tomb enclosure predating Humayun’s Tomb, inside the complex. Citations: Catherine B. Asher (1992), 'Architecture of Mughal India'; Y.D. Sharma (1974), 'Delhi and its Neighbourhood (ASI)'.

Island fortress on the Yamuna, later converted into a state prison. Citations: Y.D. Sharma (1974), 'Delhi and its Neighbourhood (ASI)'; Swapna Liddle (2011), 'Chandni Chowk: The Shopkeeper's Delight'.
